fps.identity_note: location_id is a name-based ASCII slug, independent of coordinates. Renaming changes the ID; position codes are not unique identifiers.

coordinate_system.precision_note: Manual approximate image readings, not surveyed coordinates. Decimal places are computational precision, not positional accuracy. Geographic features use representative label centers, not boundaries.
coordinate_system.coverage_note: Index of manually transcribed visible labels, supplemented by established markets at engine-inferred coordinates when the poster has no indexed label. Each location's method identifies its source.
